_meta: Phase 1 S1 触发器移植层。源=活库 prosrc（/tmp 取证重生成于 internal/testdb）。命名映射：每个 PG 函数 → 逐表 SQLite 触发器；角色/会话语义（current_setting('role')/actor/consent/digest/时区表）显式 app_pending，绝不静默丢弃。

triggers.name: domains_touch_updated_at
triggers.when: NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at
triggers.body: UPDATE domains SET updated_at = CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000000 WHERE id = NEW.id

urmail_ai_configuration_consent_guard.note: 版本自增与插入默认为机械部分；role/consent/sha256 为会话语义
urmail_ai_configuration_consent_guard.app_pending: AI_TENANT_CONSENT_REQUIRED / AI_CLOUD_CONSENT_STALE（role+actor 判定）与 configuration_digest（sha256）→ S2 装饰器与 S4 迁移承接

triggers.name: ai_config_version_keep_or_bump
triggers.when: NEW.configuration_version IS NOT (CASE WHEN NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode OR NEW.provider IS NOT OLD.provider OR NEW.endpoint IS NOT OLD.endpoint OR NEW.model IS NOT OLD.model OR NEW.cloud_scope_hash IS NOT OLD.cloud_scope_hash THEN OLD.configuration_version + 1 ELSE OLD.configuration_version END)
triggers.body:
SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.configuration_version >= 9007199254740991 AND (NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode OR NEW.provider IS NOT OLD.provider OR NEW.endpoint IS NOT OLD.endpoint OR NEW.model IS NOT OLD.model OR NEW.cloud_scope_hash IS NOT OLD.cloud_scope_hash) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'AI_CONFIGURATION_VERSION_EXHAUSTED') END;
UPDATE ai_provider_configs SET configuration_version = CASE WHEN NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode OR NEW.provider IS NOT OLD.provider OR NEW.endpoint IS NOT OLD.endpoint OR NEW.model IS NOT OLD.model OR NEW.cloud_scope_hash IS NOT OLD.cloud_scope_hash THEN OLD.configuration_version + 1 ELSE OLD.configuration_version END WHERE id = NEW.id

triggers.name: ai_config_insert_defaults
triggers.when: NEW.configuration_version IS NOT 1 OR NEW.tenant_local_only IS NOT 1 OR NEW.cloud_consent_digest IS NOT '' OR NEW.cloud_consent_scope_hash IS NOT '' OR NEW.cloud_consent_by IS NOT NULL OR NEW.cloud_consent_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.cloud_consent_revoked_at IS NOT NULL
triggers.body: UPDATE ai_provider_configs SET configuration_version = 1, tenant_local_only = 1, cloud_consent_digest = '', cloud_consent_scope_hash = '', cloud_consent_by = NULL, cloud_consent_at = NULL, cloud_consent_revoked_at = NULL WHERE id = NEW.id

urmail_alias_sender_logins_guard.note: sender_logins 为 TEXT(JSON 数组)；catchall 禁登录、路由变更清空、逐登录校验归属

triggers.name: alias_sender_logins_catchall_guard
triggers.when: NEW.kind = 'catchall' AND json_array_length(NEW.sender_logins) > 0

triggers.name: alias_sender_logins_membership_guard
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.sender_logins) je WHERE lower(je.value) IS NOT je.value OR length(je.value) > 254 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mailboxes m WHERE m.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND m.address = je.value AND m.status <> 'deleted'))

triggers.name: alias_sender_logins_routing_reset
triggers.when: (NEW.target IS NOT OLD.target OR NEW.local_part IS NOT OLD.local_part OR NEW.kind IS NOT OLD.kind OR NEW.domain_id IS NOT OLD.domain_id) AND NEW.sender_logins IS OLD.sender_logins
triggers.body: UPDATE mailbox_aliases SET sender_logins = '[]' WHERE id = NEW.id

urmail_archive_purge_guard.note: legal_hold 期间禁 purge；purge 仅限 30 天前已删且未 hold 的条目

triggers.name: archive_hold_purge_guard
triggers.when: NEW.legal_hold AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM archive_content WHERE entry_id = NEW.id AND (purge_started_at IS NOT NULL OR purged_at IS NOT NULL))

triggers.name: archive_content_purge_eligibility
triggers.when: NEW.purge_started_at IS NOT NULL AND (OLD.purge_started_at IS NULL OR NEW.purged_at IS NOT OLD.purged_at) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM archive_entries WHERE id = NEW.entry_id AND tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND NOT legal_hold AND deleted_at <= (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 2592000)*1000000)

urmail_billing_profile_write_guard.note: billing_document_profile 身份不可变；写权限 role 判定为会话语义
urmail_billing_profile_write_guard.app_pending: BILLING_PROFILE_FORBIDDEN（scope/tenant/owner-admin-billing role 判定）→ S2 装饰器

triggers.name: billing_profile_identity_immutable
triggers.when: OLD.key = 'billing_document_profile' AND (NEW.key IS NOT OLD.key OR NEW.scope IS NOT OLD.scope OR NEW.scope_id IS NOT OLD.scope_id)

urmail_contact_group_member_guard.note: 成员必须同租户/邮箱/通讯录且双方未删

triggers.name: contact_group_member_scope
triggers.when: NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mailbox_contact_groups g JOIN mailbox_contacts c ON c.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND c.mailbox_id = g.mailbox_id AND c.addressbook_id = g.addressbook_id WHERE g.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND g.mailbox_id = NEW.mailbox_id AND g.id = NEW.group_id AND c.id = NEW.contact_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL)

urmail_domain_provisioning_guard.note: app 写路径的 provisioning 状态冻结；dkim/mode 变更重置为 pending
urmail_domain_provisioning_guard.app_pending: DOMAIN_PROVISIONING_FORBIDDEN（role=platform/migrate 豁免与插入强制 pending 的角色分支）→ S2 装饰器（单引擎下 app 即全写方，插入强制 pending 保留在触发器）

triggers.name: domain_provisioning_reset_on_dkim_change
triggers.when: (NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode OR NEW.dkim_selector IS NOT OLD.dkim_selector OR NEW.dkim_private_key IS NOT OLD.dkim_private_key) AND (NEW.provisioning_state IS NOT 'pending' OR NEW.dns_explicit IS NOT 0)
triggers.body: UPDATE domains SET provisioning_state = 'pending', dns_explicit = 0 WHERE id = NEW.id

triggers.name: domain_provisioning_insert_pending
triggers.when: NEW.provisioning_state IS NOT 'pending' OR NEW.dns_explicit IS NOT 0 OR NEW.custom_web_enabled IS NOT 0
triggers.body: UPDATE domains SET provisioning_state = 'pending', dns_explicit = 0, custom_web_enabled = 0 WHERE id = NEW.id

urmail_guard_host_namespace.note: brand_hosts 与 domains 主机名互斥（忽略大小写与尾点）

triggers.name: domains_host_namespace_guard
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM brand_hosts WHERE lower(rtrim(hostname,'.')) = lower(rtrim(NEW.fqdn,'.')))
triggers.body: SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'hostname is reserved by a brand host')

triggers.name: brand_hosts_namespace_guard
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domains WHERE lower(rtrim(fqdn,'.')) = lower(rtrim(NEW.hostname,'.')))
triggers.body: SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'hostname is reserved by a mail domain')

urmail_guard_marketing_snapshot.note: 已发布版本/快照不可变；租户级联删除放行

triggers.name: guard_marketing_version_delete
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants WHERE id = OLD.tenant_id)

triggers.name: guard_marketing_content_delete
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants WHERE id = OLD.tenant_id)

urmail_guard_nonplatform_ai_quota.note: 配额时区冻结；填默认时区与平台写权为会话/目录依赖
urmail_guard_nonplatform_ai_quota.app_pending: AI_QUOTA_PLATFORM_REQUIRED（role）、quota_timezone 自动填充（urmail_business_timezone）、pg_timezone_names 校验 → S2/S4；AI_QUOTA_TIMEZONE_FROZEN 机械部分保留

triggers.name: ai_quota_timezone_frozen
triggers.when: OLD.quota_timezone <> '' AND NEW.quota_timezone IS NOT OLD.quota_timezone

urmail_guard_published_marketing_step.note: 已发布流程的步骤不可改；租户级联删除放行

triggers.name: guard_published_marketing_step_insert
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marketing_flow_versions WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND runtime_flow_id = NEW.flow_id)

triggers.name: guard_published_marketing_step_update
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marketing_flow_versions WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND runtime_flow_id = NEW.flow_id)

triggers.name: guard_published_marketing_step_delete
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants WHERE id = OLD.tenant_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marketing_flow_versions WHERE tenant_id = OLD.tenant_id AND runtime_flow_id = OLD.flow_id)

urmail_hold_guard.note: legal_hold 冻结条目/邮箱/域名/租户删除（单写者语义替代 advisory lock）

triggers.name: archive_entries_hold_guard_update
triggers.when: OLD.legal_hold AND (NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.mailbox_id IS NOT OLD.mailbox_id OR NEW.tenant_id IS NOT OLD.tenant_id OR NEW.path IS NOT OLD.path)

triggers.name: archive_entries_hold_guard_update2
triggers.when: NEW.legal_hold AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL

triggers.name: archive_entries_hold_guard_delete
triggers.when: OLD.legal_hold

triggers.name: mailboxes_hold_guard_update
triggers.when: NEW.status = 'deleted' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM archive_entries WHERE tenant_id = OLD.tenant_id AND mailbox_id = OLD.id AND legal_hold)

triggers.name: mailboxes_hold_guard_delete
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM archive_entries WHERE tenant_id = OLD.tenant_id AND mailbox_id = OLD.id AND legal_hold)

triggers.name: domains_hold_guard_update
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM archive_entries a JOIN mailboxes m ON m.id = a.mailbox_id AND m.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = OLD.tenant_id AND m.domain_id = OLD.id AND a.legal_hold)

triggers.name: domains_hold_guard_delete
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM archive_entries a JOIN mailboxes m ON m.id = a.mailbox_id AND m.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id = OLD.tenant_id AND m.domain_id = OLD.id AND a.legal_hold)

triggers.name: tenants_hold_guard_delete
triggers.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM archive_entries WHERE tenant_id = OLD.id AND legal_hold)

triggers.name: mailbox_storage_identity
triggers.when: NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domains d WHERE d.id = NEW.domain_id AND d.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND NEW.address = NEW.local_part || '@' || d.fqdn)

urmail_mailbox_password_version_guard.note: 改密自增版本并置 revoke_pending；非受信方改版本字段为角色语义
urmail_mailbox_password_version_guard.app_pending: 非受信写方直接改 password_version/password_revoke_pending 的拒绝（role 判定）→ S2 装饰器；插入版本 0 断言保留

triggers.name: mailbox_password_version_exhausted
triggers.when: NEW.password_hash IS NOT OLD.password_hash AND OLD.password_version = 9223372036854775807

triggers.name: mailbox_password_version_bump
triggers.when: NEW.password_hash IS NOT OLD.password_hash AND (NEW.password_version IS NOT OLD.password_version + 1 OR NEW.password_revoke_pending IS NOT 1)
triggers.body: UPDATE mailboxes SET password_version = OLD.password_version + 1, password_revoke_pending = 1 WHERE id = NEW.id

urmail_mailbox_sieve_mode_guard.note: sieve_mode 不可变；legacy 元数据只读；legacy 导入授权为角色语义
urmail_mailbox_sieve_mode_guard.app_pending: LEGACY_SIEVE_IMPORT_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED（trusted role + migration entitlement）→ S2 装饰器

triggers.name: mailbox_sieve_mode_transition_guard
triggers.when: NEW.sieve_mode IS NOT OLD.sieve_mode

triggers.name: mailbox_legacy_sieve_readonly
triggers.when: OLD.sieve_mode = 'legacy_v80' AND NEW.sieve_script IS NOT OLD.sieve_script

urmail_recall_guard.note: recall 起始 pending、终态受限于 pending/failed/expired

triggers.name: recall_state_guard_insert
triggers.when: NEW.status <> 'pending'

triggers.name: recall_state_guard_update
triggers.when: OLD.status <> 'pending' OR NEW.status NOT IN('pending','failed','expired')
triggers.body: SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'remote delivery recall is not confirmed')

urmail_recall_message_identity_guard.note: preview 快照内 copies[].message_guid 必须为合法字符串（JSON1 展开 + GLOB 字符类）

triggers.name: recall_message_identity_guard
triggers.when: NEW.status = 'preview' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(json_extract(CAST(NEW.preview_snapshot AS TEXT), '$.copies')) copy WHERE json_typeof(json_extract(copy.value, '$.message_guid')) <> 'string' OR length(json_extract(copy.value, '$.message_guid')) < 1 OR length(json_extract(copy.value, '$.message_guid')) > 512 OR json_extract(copy.value, '$.message_guid') NOT GLOB '[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._,+:=@-]*')

urmail_require_content_owner.note: owner 角色判定与撤销簿记为会话语义；保留不可变与基本合法性
urmail_require_content_owner.app_pending: COMPLIANCE_OWNER_REQUIRED（owner role）、revoked_by/revoked_at 簿记、granted_by=actor 校验 → S2 装饰器；expires/reason 合法性保留为机械

triggers.name: compliance_grants_immutable_guard
triggers.when: (NEW.tenant_id IS NOT OLD.tenant_id OR NEW.user_id IS NOT OLD.user_id OR NEW.scope IS NOT OLD.scope OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at OR NEW.reason IS NOT OLD.reason OR NEW.granted_by IS NOT OLD.granted_by OR NEW.owner_confirmed_at IS NOT OLD.owner_confirmed_at) OR NOT NEW.revoked

triggers.name: compliance_grants_validity_guard
triggers.when: NEW.scope IN('full_content','export') AND (NEW.expires_at IS NULL OR length(trim(NEW.reason)) = 0 OR length(NEW.reason) > 2000)

urmail_require_encrypted_totp.note: mfa_secret 必须 enc:v1: 前缀

triggers.name: totp_encrypted_writes
triggers.when: NEW.mfa_secret IS NOT NULL AND NEW.mfa_secret NOT LIKE 'enc:v1:%'

urmail_require_grant_independence.note: 显式自授权禁止；granted_by 为空的会话派生分支归应用层
urmail_require_grant_independence.app_pending: granted_by IS NULL 且 user_id=当前 actor 的自授权判定（会话）→ S2 装饰器（PG 侧由 owner_guard 先行置 granted_by）

triggers.name: compliance_grants_independence_guard
triggers.when: NEW.scope IN('metadata_only','full_content','export') AND NEW.granted_by IS NOT NULL AND NEW.granted_by = NEW.user_id

urmail_require_marketing_admin.app_pending: MARKETING_FORBIDDEN（tenant 匹配 + owner/admin role，会话语义）→ S2 装饰器全量承接，引擎层无触发器

urmail_require_open_ticket.note: 单引擎下全写方视同 app：closed 票禁止追加消息（原文 role 分支吸收）

triggers.name: ticket_messages_open_guard
triggers.when: NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tickets WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND id = NEW.ticket_id AND status IN('open','pending'))

urmail_require_tenant_content_admin.app_pending: COMPLIANCE_GRANT_ROLE_REQUIRED（owner/admin 会话判定）→ S2 装饰器全量承接，引擎层无触发器

urmail_reserve_mailbox_storage.note: 邮箱身份不可变 + 地址预约登记与占用断言

triggers.name: mailbox_storage_identity_immutable
triggers.when: NEW.address IS NOT OLD.address OR NEW.local_part IS NOT OLD.local_part OR NEW.domain_id IS NOT OLD.domain_id OR NEW.tenant_id IS NOT OLD.tenant_id

triggers.name: mailbox_storage_reserve
triggers.body:
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO mailbox_storage_reservations(address, mailbox_id) VALUES(NEW.address, NEW.id);
SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mailbox_storage_reservations WHERE address = NEW.address AND mailbox_id = NEW.id) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'MAILBOX_STORAGE_ADDRESS_RESERVED') END

urmail_resource_guard.note: 租户状态/配额（settings 行谓词 limit 内联）；域名删除走 SQL，非角色部分全机械；单写者替代 advisory lock
urmail_resource_guard.app_pending: urmail_domain_mail_ready 未就绪时 platform 豁免分支（role）→ S2 装饰器

triggers.name: domains_resource_guard_insert
triggers.when: NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants WHERE id = NEW.tenant_id AND status IN('active','pending')) OR (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CAST(json_extract(value,'$') AS INTEGER) FROM settings WHERE scope='tenant' AND scope_id=NEW.tenant_id AND key='mailbox_domain_limit'), (SELECT CAST(json_extract(value,'$') AS INTEGER) FROM settings WHERE scope='platform' AND scope_id=0 AND key='mailbox_domain_limit'), -1)) <> -1 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM domains WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id) >= (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CAST(json_extract(value,'$') AS INTEGER) FROM settings WHERE scope='tenant' AND scope_id=NEW.tenant_id AND key='mailbox_domain_limit'), (SELECT CAST(json_extract(value,'$') AS INTEGER) FROM settings WHERE scope='platform' AND scope_id=0 AND key='mailbox_domain_limit'), -1))
triggers.body: SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants WHERE id = NEW.tenant_id AND status IN('active','pending')) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED') ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'DOMAIN_QUOTA_EXCEEDED') END

triggers.name: domains_resource_guard_update
triggers.when: NEW.tenant_id IS NOT OLD.tenant_id
triggers.body: SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants WHERE id = NEW.tenant_id AND status IN('active','pending')) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED') END

triggers.name: mailboxes_resource_guard_insert
triggers.when: NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants WHERE id = NEW.tenant_id AND status IN('active','pending')) OR ((SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CAST(json_extract(value,'$') AS INTEGER) FROM settings WHERE scope='tenant' AND scope_id=NEW.tenant_id AND key='mailbox_limit'), (SELECT CAST(json_extract(value,'$') AS INTEGER) FROM settings WHERE scope='platform' AND scope_id=0 AND key='mailbox_limit'), -1)) <> -1 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM mailboxes WHERE tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND status <> 'deleted') >= (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CAST(json_extract(value,'$') AS INTEGER) FROM settings WHERE scope='tenant' AND scope_id=NEW.tenant_id AND key='mailbox_limit'), (SELECT CAST(json_extract(value,'$') AS INTEGER) FROM settings WHERE scope='platform' AND scope_id=0 AND key='mailbox_limit'), -1)))
triggers.body: SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants WHERE id = NEW.tenant_id AND status IN('active','pending')) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED') ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'MAILBOX_QUOTA_EXCEEDED') END

triggers.name: mailboxes_resource_guard_delete
triggers.when: OLD.status <> 'deleted' OR OLD.usage_measured_at IS NULL OR OLD.usage_error IS NOT NULL OR OLD.usage_measured_at < (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 600)*1000000 OR OLD.bytes_used > 0

urmail_restore_quarantine_guard.note: 恢复隔离激活期间拒写（urmail_restore_quarantine_active 内联为单行表读取）

triggers.name: domains_restore_quarantine_guard
triggers.when: COALESCE((SELECT active FROM restore_quarantine), 0)

urmail_retention_confirmation_guard.note: 激活策略必须挂已确认 preview

urmail_retention_management_guard.note: 角色/授权判定为会话语义；策略不可变与停用例外保留为机械
urmail_retention_management_guard.app_pending: RETENTION_MANAGE_REQUIRED 全链（owner/admin 会话、created_by=actor、compliance grant 授权）、preview 生成/确认簿记与 15 分钟窗 → S2 装饰器与 S4 承接

triggers.name: retention_policy_immutable_guard
triggers.when: NEW.active AND (NEW.tenant_id IS NOT OLD.tenant_id OR NEW.retention_days IS NOT OLD.retention_days OR NEW.action IS NOT OLD.action OR NEW.created_by IS NOT OLD.created_by OR NEW.confirmed_preview IS NOT OLD.confirmed_preview OR NEW.authorization_grant_id IS NOT OLD.authorization_grant_id)

urmail_setting_limit.note: 纯 SQL 函数（settings 行谓词 limit 读取），无触发器——已内联进 urmail_resource_guard 触发器

urmail_suppression_no_weaken.note: suppression 身份不可变；强 reason 不得弱化为 manual

triggers.name: suppression_no_weaken_guard
triggers.when: NEW.tenant_id IS NOT OLD.tenant_id OR NEW.email IS NOT OLD.email OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id

triggers.name: suppression_reason_guard
triggers.when: OLD.reason <> 'manual' AND NEW.reason IS NOT OLD.reason
